name: Seamless.ai
summary: B2B contact database with AI list-building, plus an MCP server so Claude or ChatGPT can run the searching and enrichment. Nothing above the free plan (1 user, 50 credits) carries a published price; the only quantity their FAQ names is a Pro floor of 10,000 annual credits. Independent tests put deliverability near 74%, and contracts auto-renew with 30-60 days' notice to cancel.
best_for: teams that want a huge real-time contact database and AI list-building for less than ZoomInfo, and can tolerate cleaning the data
skip_if: data accuracy is your top priority (ZoomInfo bounces far less), or you want simple no-contract pricing — the bounce rates and auto-renewal bite
honest_knock: Data accuracy is the recurring complaint — independent tests put email deliverability around 74% (20–30% bounce) versus ZoomInfo's ~2–3%, so real cost per usable contact climbs. The buying experience is the other weak spot: sales-led, auto-renew with 30–60 day written cancellation, and reports of charges after a 'confirmed' cancellation.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-30 on seamless.ai/pricing, seamless.ai/pricing-inquiry, Seamless's help centre and seamless.ai/llms.txt) The pricing page no longer shows plans: seamless.ai/pricing now forwards the browser to seamless.ai/pricing-inquiry, a demo-request form headed 'Perfect Pricing for Startups to the Fortune 500' that offers special pricing for unlimited users, bulk credits, prospector, job changes, buyer intent and enrichment, and carries no amount, no plan table and no FAQ. Still no published price above the free plan, in a fifth reading. Seamless's help centre now states the allowances: Free is 50 Universal Credits that do not replenish; a Basic licence gets 250 Universal Credits a month and a Pro licence 10,000 a month, both refreshing on the contract date; bulk pool credits are bought up front and do not replenish. Legacy Pro accounts created before 1 April 2026 keep 1,000 credits a day, no longer sold. Researching a contact costs 1 credit for the whole profile, a Data Enrich row 1, an Autopilot contact 1, and an AI Assistant interaction or AI-written message 0.2. Buyer Intent runs on separate Intent Topics, not credits. Credit Back Protection refunds the credit when Seamless's own check flags an email as invalid, but not for soft bounces, role addresses like info@, or phone numbers. Until 7 September the pricing page's FAQ said Pro starts at 10,000 annual credits; the help article says 10,000 a month, so ask which one your quote uses. Third-party guides report an entry around $147 a month for roughly 250 credits; that matches the Basic allowance, but the dollar figure is not Seamless's number.

exit_test.what: Company-domain search; CRM kit used only as an evaluation matrix.
exit_test.awkward: Login was followed by phone verification handled by the account owner. Onboarding preselected United States and Canada in the location filters; we skipped this step, and do not infer the effective search geography. Both our own domains returned zero matches with the observed Default company matching. The hubspot.com control returned one result, with Company Phones and About blurred behind Find. We did not reveal fields or spend credits: the balance stayed at fifty. In our two dated tests Apollo found aibuildermarketplace.com and did not find marketingandsalessoftware.com; Seamless found neither. This limited comparison does not establish broader database coverage. No kit contacts were entered, no export obtained, no mailbox connected and no prices inspected.

sessions.what: Tested by our team on 31 October 2026 with the free credits: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. We searched the company database for two of our own sites and one well-known company, without spending credits or revealing any contact details.
findings: The account came with 50 free credits and no card. After logging in it asked for phone verification.
The setup filters preselect the United States and Canada as locations; we skipped them.
A company search for AI Builder Marketplace and for Marketing and Sales Software found neither.
A control search for hubspot.com found it, but the phone numbers and description stay blurred until you click 'Find', which costs credits.
Searching did not use any credits.

open_questions.question: Can you publish a price, or a starting price, for the plans that are quote-only?
Can a customer cancel at any time, and what happens to an annual plan that is cancelled mid-term?
Which data can a customer export, in which formats, on which plans?
Where is customer data stored, and can a customer choose the region?
Is there a minimum number of seats or users on any plan?

vendor_mcp.what: Hosted server at mcp.seamless.ai/mcp: 54 tools across 11 domains — contact and company search, research and enrichment, lists, saved searches, campaigns, tasks, templates, email drafts and sends, call logging and the activity feed — plus 7 read-only seamless:// resources for credit balance, templates and email accounts. Every tool carries a read, write or destructive label so the client can ask before anything with side effects runs. OAuth 2.1, or an API key for clients without it.
vendor_mcp.plan: Split by licence, not by price: search, research, lists, saved searches and the credit/user lookups are open to all users; campaigns, tasks, templates, email, calls, activity and Connect config need a Connect licence, with campaigns and tasks needing Connect (full). MCP also has to be switched on for the account. No price for the MCP server itself is published.
vendor_mcp.note: The vendor's own MCP server, from our MCP research; it works with your own account at the vendor.
